p: Draft written by SpecBridge from the code at the frozen version, for SPEC-66. Please review it before use. The Actual result and Pass/Fail columns are for the tester.
What the ticket asks: Sort allergies in the patient chart by severity (severe first, then moderate, then mild) and then by recency.
Test scope: Full: new or changed behaviour on screen.
h3: AC1: Allergies are listed by severity: severe first, then moderate, then mild.

p.em: Ticket: “Allergies are listed by severity: severe first, then moderate, then mild.”

td.p: Verify allergies are sorted by severity (severe first, then moderate, then mild) in the Allergies widget

ul.li: A patient chart exists with recorded allergies across severe, moderate, and mild severities (<patient with mixed severity allergies>)

ol.li: Navigate to the patient chart for <patient with mixed severity allergies>.
Locate the Allergies widget on the page.
Observe the sequence of allergy tags displayed under the Allergies section.

td.p: Allergies are displayed in order of severity: severe allergies appear first, followed by moderate allergies, and mild allergies appear last.
Verify allergies with moderate and mild severities sort moderate before mild when severe is absent

ul.li: A patient chart exists with only moderate and mild allergies recorded (<patient with moderate and mild allergies>)

ol.li: Navigate to the patient chart for <patient with moderate and mild allergies>.
Locate the Allergies widget.
Observe the ordering of the displayed allergy tags.

td.p: Moderate allergies are listed before mild allergies.

h3: AC2: Allergies with the same severity are listed most recent first.

p.em: Ticket: “Allergies with the same severity are listed most recent first.”

td.p: Verify allergies with the same severity are sorted most recent first

ul.li: A patient chart exists with multiple severe allergies recorded at different times (<patient with multiple severe allergies>)

ol.li: Navigate to the patient chart for <patient with multiple severe allergies>.
Locate the Allergies widget.
Observe the relative order of the severe allergies.

td.p: The most recently updated severe allergy is displayed before older severe allergies.
Verify recency ordering within moderate severity group

ul.li: A patient chart exists with multiple moderate allergies updated at different dates (<patient with multiple moderate allergies>)

ol.li: Navigate to the patient chart for <patient with multiple moderate allergies>.
Locate the Allergies widget.
Observe the relative order of the moderate allergies.

td.p: The moderate allergy with the most recent lastUpdated date is listed first among the moderate allergies.

h3: AC3: The ordering of allergies is consistent across both the patient summary and the full Allergies page.

p.em: Ticket: “The order is the same on the patient summary and on the full Allergies page.”

td.p: Verify ordering consistency between patient summary and full Allergies page

ul.li: A patient chart exists with multiple allergies of varying severities and update dates (<patient with diverse allergies>)

ol.li: Navigate to the patient summary page for <patient with diverse allergies>.
Observe the list order of allergies in the patient summary view.
Navigate to the full Allergies page (allergies-details-widget).
Compare the list order of allergies on the full Allergies page table with the order on the patient summary.

td.p: The ordering of allergies (severe first, then moderate, then mild; ordered by recency within each severity) is identical on both the patient summary and the full Allergies page.
Verify empty state consistency across patient summary and full Allergies page

ul.li: A patient chart exists with no recorded allergies (<patient with no allergies>)

ol.li: Navigate to the patient summary for <patient with no allergies>.
Observe the Allergies section on the summary page.
Navigate to the full Allergies page.
Observe the display on the full Allergies page.

td.p: Both the summary view and full Allergies page present consistent empty/unknown state messages ('Unknown' on tile/list and empty state with 'allergy intolerances' display text on full page).

ol.li: Should severity sorting logic be centralized inside the `useAllergies` hook (`allergy-intolerance.resource.ts`) so that all widgets (tile, list, detailed summary) share the exact same severity-first recency-second sorting order?

ac:rich-text-body.p: What the writers noticed in the code:

ul.li: Code Implementation Discrepancy: `allergies-list.extension.tsx` (E3) applies `severityOrder` sorting to `sortedAllergies`, but `allergies-tile.extension.tsx` (E2) and `allergies-detailed-summary.component.tsx` (E4) directly render `allergies` from `useAllergies` (E5) without sorting by `severityOrder`. Consequently, the full Allergies page and summary tile currently display allergies ordered solely by recency (`lastUpdated`), failing AC3 consistency across screens.
